content.value: Examine whether or not the straight lines $\frac { x - 3 } { 3 } = \frac { y - 8 } { - 1 } = \frac { z - 3 } { 1 } \mathrm { a n d } \frac { x + 3 } { - 3 } = \frac { y + 7 } { 2 } = \frac { z - 6 } { 4 }$ are coplanar. If they are non-coplanar, then find the shortest distance between them.
